activities.name: Sanur Beach Sunrise Walk
activities.description: Sanur faces east — the only beach in Bali where the sunrise is unobstructed. Walk the 5km beachfront promenade from Pura Blanjong to Mertasari Beach before 06:30 for a crowd-free golden hour over the strait toward Nusa Penida.

activities.name: Day Trip to Nusa Penida
activities.description: Fast boat from Sanur harbour to Nusa Penida: Kelingking sea-cliff viewpoint, Crystal Bay snorkelling over coral gardens, and Broken Beach natural arch. Boats depart 07:00–09:00; journey ~45 min. Book the combined snorkel + viewpoint tour.

activities.name: Dinner at Café Batu Jimbar
activities.description: Sanur's most enduring garden restaurant — open-air pavilions under frangipanis, Indonesian-fusion menu, and a wine list unusual for this price tier. Saturday evening jazz sets. Reservations recommended.

activities.name: Cove Dahayu Sanctuary
activities.description: Boutique spa set inside a restored Dutch colonial villa — four treatment rooms, traditional Balinese boreh scrub, and coconut-milk bath. No walk-ins: advance booking required. 90-min Harmony Journey recommended.

activities.name: Yoga at Power Of Now Oasis
activities.description: Beachfront yoga studio directly on Sanur beach. Morning Hatha at 07:00, Vinyasa at 09:00. Drop-in welcome. The open-air shala has an unobstructed view over the Lombok Strait — sessions run regardless of weather.

activities.name: Sanur–Gianyar Cycling Route
activities.description: 30km flat coastal cycling route north through Lebih and Gianyar rice fields. Rent hybrid bikes at Sanur promenade (from ~$5/day). The road shoulder is wide and traffic light past Lebih. Bring water — no convenience stores for 15km past Kusamba.
